metadata.description: Ad Suite PM skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: ad-suite-skills
plugins.description: PM-focused PRD writing for Ad Suite features — background, user stories, user interaction & design, ROI/RICE scoring

plugins.name: nano-banana-pro
plugins.description: Generate detailed, high-quality documentation images using Google's Gemini 3 Pro

plugins.name: release-tools
plugins.description: Generate Slack-style release notes from a Confluence release manual page and linked JIRA tickets

plugins.name: figma-prd-designer
plugins.description: Reads a Confluence PRD and builds Figma screen designs using the target file's existing design system — reusing components first, modifying existing ones second, and creating new reusable components only when nothing else fits

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: Ingest Confluence/Jira/Slack/local/website content into an LLM wiki — including bulk ingest of a whole Confluence space or a website sitemap — describe images via a nano-banana-pro-compatible endpoint on diff, lint the wiki, and bootstrap new wikis

plugins.name: secretary
plugins.description: Personal secretary agent: create and track todos, deadlines, and subtasks in a git-committed local file store, link tasks to llm-wiki references, surface a due-soon/overdue digest at the start of every session, and automatically reconcile new action items from Slack and Outlook into existing tasks without duplicating them
